metaDescription: Order custom rectangular luggage accessories for bulk branding. Perfect for corporate gifts and travel giveaways. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Rectangular luggage accessories offer a classic, professional shape that stands out on any bag. From leather tags to durable plastic identifiers, this shape provides maximum surface area for your logo or message. Ideal for corporate travel sets or employee recognition gifts, rectangular accessories pair well with screen printing, debossing, or full-color digital printing. Choose from materials like genuine leather or recycled plastics to match your brand's values.
